company.name: Freedx
company.shortDescription: Freedx is a Dubai- and El Salvador–based cryptocurrency exchange platform.
company.description: Freedx is a Dubai- and El Salvador–based cryptocurrency exchange platform that enables users to buy, sell, trade, and manage digital assets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies. The company positions itself as a next-generation centralized crypto exchange (CEX) focused on combining institutional-grade security with a user-friendly trading experience for both beginner and advanced traders.

productsAndServices.description: A digital asset trading platform for account-based cryptocurrency transactions, custody, deposits, withdrawals, order management, and market monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Freedx Crypto Exchange Platform

productsAndServices.description: A cryptocurrency spot market for buying and selling digital assets using market and limit orders, real-time charts, and an order book.
productsAndServices.name: Spot Trading

productsAndServices.description: A leveraged digital asset derivatives service supporting perpetual futures, isolated margin, take-profit and stop-loss orders, and liquidation management.
productsAndServices.name: Futures Trading

productsAndServices.description: A cryptocurrency conversion service for swapping one digital asset for another through a quoted, one-click transaction without using an order book.
productsAndServices.name: Instant Convert

productsAndServices.description: A fiat-to-crypto purchase service that lets users buy cryptocurrencies using cards, bank transfers, SEPA, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Google Pay, and other payment methods.
productsAndServices.name: Instant Buy

productsAndServices.description: A platform area where users can participate in cryptocurrency campaigns and other activities to receive eligible rewards.
productsAndServices.name: Rewards Hub
